LanguageData.RR_Evidence_Blank: Company record book, still blank. This is the journal the company issues you: carry it through a gate and a colonist writes the route into it as they explore. Bring it home and it becomes the case record you analyse and get paid for. Lose the book, lose the run.
LanguageData.RR_Evidence_CompanyBookDesc:
The journal the company issues you. It records where a crew went and what they found, and it is the thing you get paid for.

1. Have a colonist carry it through a gate.
2. Walk it through each required room. The survey writes itself as they go.
3. Bring it home and put it on the shelf you designated as the records archive.
4. Assign a researcher to analyse it at a powered bench.

Lose the book and you lose that run's record, not the branch's work.
LanguageData.RR_Evidence_Unregistered: Somebody left this here before you. It has no case record on this branch yet - carry it out and take it home, and it will open one.
LanguageData.RR_Evidence_NextStep: Right-click it with a colonist to carry it out. Take it home, put it on the shelf you designate as the records archive, then analyse it at a powered field analysis bench.
LanguageData.RR_Evidence_InvalidRecord: The recording cannot be linked to this coordinate and case. Preserve it and review the case record.
LanguageData.RR_Evidence_NotReady: Analysis requires all six required room surveys, a recorded route mismatch, the secured recording, a powered headquarters analysis bench and a capable researcher with Intellectual 4.
LanguageData.RR_Event_EvidenceSecured: The record book is at headquarters. Complete the route and distortion observations, shelve it in the records archive, then assign a researcher to analysis.

LanguageData.RR_Research_NeedsInsight: Analyze recovered evidence to earn the insight this project needs.
LanguageData.RR_Research_NotReady: Research requires an active company project and a qualified researcher working at a powered headquarters analysis bench.

LanguageData.RR_UI_LabInstructions: Designate an existing research bench above, then assign Research work to an available researcher with Intellectual 4 or higher. Secured evidence is analyzed before active company research. Native bench efficiency applies; a hi-tech bench needs power. Keep physical access to the interaction cell and evidence. Clearing the company designation leaves ordinary research available.

LanguageData.RR_Evidence_PreviousObjectMissing: This coordinate's evidence was already created. Its loss is preserved; revisiting does not create a second copy.

LanguageData.RR_UI_EvidenceFieldWorkRemaining: Carry the record book through each required room. At the corridor junction, set a glow pod down and designate it as a numbered marker before investigating the next passage. A second marker at the last good junction gives you something stable to compare against. Incomplete observations can be finished on a later trip to the same site.
